text:
Got it, two parts.
1) Never auto-bet/bid, and a big red warning in every scanner, for types that lose with a big sample: agreed and requested. Right now the first one is: player prop Overs (n=527, -15%, t=-3.4); 6-13 h-ahead props and 4-6% EV props are candidates I'll check overlap on. The code already has a 'Profit-proven only' switch (blocks losing types, warns by hand); I'll make it default ON for the engine and the auto-bet, and turn the warning into a large red X on every row/Bet sheet. 
2) Bet the Under instead? The data says no: prop Unders also lost (n=363, -4%, t=-0.3) at the same time Overs lost 15%. A bet losing 15% on a price that beat the close (CLV +1.9%) means mostly variance and book vig, not a mirror-image edge; the other side pays the vig again, so the opposite of a -EV bet is not +EV. I won't flip them.
Another Claude session holds the repo lease right now, so the code change is queued for it (note on the board, plus TASKS). Reply 'force' if you want me to build it myself immediately.
